roles.name: Super Administrator
roles.description: Master platform overseer across all universities, campuses, and system settings.

roles.name: System Administrator
roles.description: Technical configuration, integrations, user management, and operational maintenance.

roles.name: Vice-Chancellor / Executive
roles.description: Executive institutional oversight, strategic performance dashboards, and read-only reporting.

roles.name: Registrar
roles.description: Authoritative student records, academic calendar, graduation, transcripts, and official certifications.

roles.name: Academic Affairs Officer
roles.description: Curriculum setup, programme requirements, semester calendar, and results administration.

roles.name: Faculty Dean
roles.description: Faculty oversight, academic workload, teaching allocations, and faculty-level result moderation.

roles.name: Head of Department
roles.description: Departmental courses, course offerings, teaching assignments, and departmental result reviews.

roles.name: Admissions Officer
roles.description: Application processing, document verification, applicant scoring, and admissions recommendation.

roles.name: Finance Officer / Bursar
roles.description: Fee schedules, student invoicing, payment verification, receipts, reconciliation, and refunds.

roles.name: Lecturer / Instructor
roles.description: Assigned course offerings, class lists, attendance recording, assessment setup, and mark sheets.

roles.name: Academic Advisor
roles.description: Assigned advisees, academic progression monitoring, advising notes, and registration guidance.

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Personal profile, course registration, timetable, attendance, results, and fee payments.

roles.name: Applicant
roles.description: Admission application submission, document upload, status tracking, and offer acceptance.

roles.name: Librarian
roles.description: Catalogue management, circulation, loans, reservations, and library fine administration.

roles.name: Hostel Officer
roles.description: Residence halls, room inventories, bed allocations, check-in/out, and maintenance.

roles.name: Human Resources Officer
roles.description: Staff records, employment contracts, leave administration, and teaching load tracking.

roles.name: Internal / External Auditor
roles.description: Read-only compliance verification across audit trails and financial ledgers.

permissions.description: View applicant records, submitted forms, and document uploads
Review, score rubrics, and add reviewer remarks to applications
Approve admission offers, rejection decisions, and issue admission letters
Create and publish admission cycles, application periods, and fees
Manage academic curriculum, programme versions, and course credit structures
Create and edit courses, prerequisites, and syllabus content
Schedule semester course offerings, assign lecturers, and set class capacities
Register students for course offerings and enforce prerequisite checks
Approve prerequisite overrides, late registrations, and credit overload
Draft semester timetable schedules, room allocations, and clash detection
Officially publish finalized campus and class timetables to staff and students
Log student class session attendance and calculate semester eligibility
Amend past attendance records with justification audit notes
Enter and submit coursework assessments and semester exam marks
Perform departmental moderation, marks standardisation, and statistical reviews
Dean and Senate approval of moderated examination results
Publish final approved grades to student transcript portals
Execute post-publication grade corrections under Senate audit mandate
Generate tuition invoices, laboratory fees, and billings
Inspect student billing ledgers, outstanding balances, and aging summaries
Post verified bank deposits, mobile money receipts, and manual payments
Initiate student refund vouchers and fee adjustments
Execute dual-control approval for student refunds and credit disbursements
Grant approved institutional scholarships, discounts, and fee waivers
Place and lift financial registration holds based on fee balance thresholds
Reconcile daily merchant settlements and bank feeds
View official student files, matriculation details, and biodata
Authorize status changes: suspension, withdrawal, leave of absence, or completion
Issue certified digital and embossed academic transcripts
Generate official letters of introduction, English proficiency, and completion
Catalog new print books, journals, and digital repository items
Manage loans, renewals, returns, reservations, and overdue library fines
Manage hostel blocks, rooms, bed inventory, and maintenance logs
Allocate rooms to approved student applicants and process check-ins
Maintain employee directories, academic ranks, contracts, and job designations
Review and approve faculty and administrative staff leave requests
Broadcast institutional announcements and campus SMS/email dispatches
Triage and resolve student academic and ICT support tickets
Access recruitment intake KPIs, conversion funnels, and demographics
Access graduation trends, retention rates, and grade distribution charts
Access fee collection analytics, revenue forecasts, and outstanding debt summaries
Access compliance audit logs, user login trails, and security events
Assign, modify, and revoke RBAC roles and granular permission scopes
Inspect authentication profiles, MFA enrollment, and session statuses
Reset user credentials, lock/unlock accounts, and suspend login access
Search immutable system audit events, changes, and access attempts
Configure system parameters, academic terms, and cloud integrations

setting_value.subject: Re: 2026/2027 Academic Year Governance & Quota Compliance Directive
setting_value.body:
Dear Master Super Administrator,

Thank you for the directive. We have verified our institutional role quotas, confirmed MFA enrollment across all active system administrators, and reviewed our school portal sidebar modules.

Everything is compliant and operational on our campus.

Warm regards,
Andronicus Johnson
System Administrator • Accra Institute of Technology

setting_value.subject: 2026/2027 Academic Year Governance & Quota Compliance Directive
setting_value.body:
Dear Institutional Administrators,

Please be advised that the 2026/2027 multi-tenant governance quotas and sidebar module configurations have been finalized on the central platform.

Key Action Items:
1. Verify your institution's assigned role tiers and department limits.
2. Confirm that all active system administrators have Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) enabled.
3. Review your portal sidebar navigation items under Settings.

Warm regards,
Master Super Administrator
UMS Global Platform Governance

setting_value.subject: Scheduled Cloud Storage Engine Maintenance & Zero-Downtime Sync
setting_value.body:
Hello System Administrators,

Our engineering team will perform a routine optimization on the multi-tenant database cluster this Saturday at 02:00 UTC. All institutional portals (Universities, High Schools, and Vocational Schools) will remain online with zero cold-start impact.

No action is required on your part.

Best regards,
Platform Operations Team

setting_value.subject: End-of-Semester Bursary Reconciliation & Settlement Verification
setting_value.body:
Dear Chief Financial Officer,

Kindly ensure all pending fee waiver dual-control approvals and Paystack settlement batches for the First Semester are reconciled before the financial close deadline.

Thank you,
Master Super Administrator
